title: fix(plugin-audit,plugin-approvals)!: refuse a query over activity text, ledger snapshots or the approval snapshot for a reader withheld a field of its record (#21154)
body:
Fixes #21154
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

A filter, search, sort, grouping or aggregation over a column that carries another record's field values is now refused, in the engine's own refusal shape, for a non-system reader whose security answer withholds any field of an object the query can concern: the one parent object it names, or, when it names none, any object registered in the engine. Before this, the read-time redactions narrowed only what a row SERVES, so the predicate selected on the stored value at rest: row presence answered a probe one guess at a time, and a group key handed the stored text back. Triage ruling `5929903631` (option A), applied to every member the measurement reached (claim `5930307463`, amended `5931964383`); the unpinned rule per the seat's decisions `5933122330` (patch round 1).

## The family, by member

| Member | Columns (by class) | Measured before | Folded here |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Activity stream | the text, the record label, the recorded change | predicate answers by row presence; grouping returns the stored value | yes (the card) |
| Approval request, generic data door | the submitted-record snapshot | predicate answers by row presence; grouping returns the stored snapshot | yes (H4) |
| Compliance ledger | the before and after snapshots | predicate answers by row presence; grouping returns the stored value | yes (amendment, seat 2's note `5931903481`) |

## Per-class table — generic data door, real boot

Readers of #21081's three field classes (a field served masked, a capability-gated field with no mask, a field the reader's sets do not grant), one reader per class, plus the unrestricted reader as the control. Every restricted class read the same in every row, so the classes share a row; each class has its own pins. Status and code only.

| Reader | Column class | Probe | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| each restricted class | activity text / label / change | matching filter, parent named | 200, rows | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | activity text / label / change | non-matching filter, parent named | 200, no rows | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | activity text / label / change | filter naming no parent | 200, rows or none | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (withheld a field of a registered object) |
| each restricted class | activity text / label / change | grouping (query door) | 200, stored value as the group key | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (aggregate words) |
| each restricted class | activity text / label / change | sort | 200 | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | activity (searched set) | free-text search, matching or not | 200, rows or none | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | ledger before / after | matching and non-matching filter, parent named or not | 200, rows or none | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | ledger before / after | grouping; sort; search | 200 (grouping returns the stored value) | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | approval snapshot | matching and non-matching filter, parent named or not | 200, rows or none | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| each restricted class | approval snapshot | grouping | 200, stored snapshot as the group key | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (aggregate words) |
| restricted reader, on a parent it is served in full | activity label, ledger snapshot | matching and non-matching filter | 200, rows or none | 200, rows or none (unchanged) |
| control (unrestricted) | every column above, parent named | matching and non-matching filter, grouping, sort, search | 200, rows or none | 200, rows or none (unchanged) |
| control (unrestricted) | every column above, no parent named | filter, search | 200, rows or none | 200, rows or none (unchanged: withheld nothing on any registered object, see H2) |
| any reader | a query naming no value-bearing column | list | 200 | 200 (unchanged) |
| any restricted class | activity columns | analytics door, grouping dimension or filter | 200, stored value | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` after #21080 (merged here, measured) |

H5, the refusal matched: the engine's own answer for a non-queryable field of the parent object, measured on the same boot, is 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` with its predicate words (a filter or sort) or its aggregate words (a grouping). The new refusals carry the same code, status (`status` and `statusCode`) and first sentence, naming the guarded column, followed by one sentence naming the remedy. They name nothing about the parent's fields.

## H2 — which parent, and why

Rule: a query that pins ONE parent object, by equality on the parent-object column at the root of its filter (or inside a root `$and`), is answered when the reader is served every field of it. A query that pins none is answered only when the reader is served every field of every object registered in the engine (the declared set, patch round 1), and is refused otherwise, whenever the security service is wired.

Why not the parents the query reaches: the only per-query knowledge of parents is the activity read gate's pre-scan, which runs the caller's own filter. Its parents are those of the rows a query MATCHES, so a matching probe would reach the withholding parent and be refused while a non-matching probe reached none and answered an empty list: the refusal itself would be the oracle, and the ruling's "matching and non-matching both refused" pin fails. The unpinned set is therefore read from metadata, never from rows: every object registered in the engine, the writers' reach and a superset of it (the CRUD mirror skips only its own exclusion list, which has grown over time, so rows about an object it now skips can be at rest). A reader withheld nothing anywhere is answered; any other reader is refused, matching probe or not.

"Served every field" is read from the serve seams themselves, never derived a second way: the activity redaction's served set (also used for the ledger) and the approval redaction's served set, asked as the caller, compared with the security service's read projection as the system. A serve seam's "no answer" (no security service) passes, since the rows are then served whole.

## Mechanism

- `plugin-audit`: `parent-field-query-guard.ts`, one engine read middleware per object (activity stream, compliance ledger), registered with ONE call in `AuditPlugin`, ahead of the activity read gate so a refused query pays no pre-scan. `activity-field-redaction.ts`, `audit-writers.ts` and `index.ts` are not changed.
- `plugin-approvals`: `payload-predicate-guard.ts`, registered beside the snapshot redaction middleware.
- Clauses judged: the engine predicate guard's set — `where` and `having` (keys and cross-field comparands), `orderBy`, `groupBy`, `aggregations` (field and filter). A free-text search arrives expanded into `where`. The projection is not judged.
- Operations: `find`, `findOne`, `count`, `aggregate`. System-context and context-less reads are not judged.

## Pins (synthetic fixtures; no title states a value or a column)

- `plugin-audit` `activity-predicate-guard.test.ts` (41) and `audit-log-predicate-guard.test.ts` (28): real kernel, engine, driver and plugin, security double; per class a matching and a non-matching probe refused, count, grouping, sort and search refused, the control and the served-in-full parent unchanged, a reader served every field of every registered object filtering and searching with no parent named as before, no-security unchanged, fail-closed, and the guard's column list held equal to the redaction's own strip.
- `plugin-approvals` `payload-predicate-guard.test.ts` (20): real engine and driver, guard mounted by the plugin's own `start`; a reader served every field of every registered object filters with no subject named as before.
- dogfood `activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` (22): real boot with the real security plugin, one reader per class plus the control, all three members, armed before measuring; the platform admin, granted the fixture's two capability sets, filters all three members with no parent named as before. dogfood `audit-log-admin-search.dogfood.test.ts` (3): stock showcase boot with the audit and approvals plugins; the seeded admin's unpinned ledger list search and activity search, matching and not, and an unpinned approval-snapshot filter answer as before.

## Acceptance notes

- **`check:system-context-census` is green.** The census page carries the two guards' registration anchors (the plugin-audit row and the approvals row) and its counts are regenerated with the page's own tooling (patch round 1, the seat's Q2).
- **Analytics door, closed by #21080.** Before #21080 the ad-hoc analytics query over the activity stream grouped by a value-bearing column and returned the stored value, because its native-SQL strategy ran no engine read middleware. #21080 routes objects carrying a read middleware through the engine, and it is merged here: re-measured, each restricted class's analytics grouping and filter answer 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the control 200.
- **The no-parent rule follows the declared set.** A query naming no parent object is answered for a reader served every field of every registered object (the stock admin, measured: withheld nothing on any of 86) and refused for a reader withheld any field anywhere; it costs 3 security-service calls per registered object per such query (258 on the stock showcase, 2 to 4 ms in process).
- **PR #21171 landed and is merged here.** The served-set composition is imported from `served-fields.ts`, its new home; `audit-plugin.ts` keeps one registration; the pins were re-run green.
- Filter-array spelling: a single-condition array reaches the guard (refused); a compound array spelling is refused earlier as malformed.
- A pin by membership (`$in`) or by more than one object is not accepted; that would be a widening.
- The clause walk is restated in the two plugins because neither depends on the security plugin's predicate guard. Carrier: none.
- The no-middleware-seam warning in `AuditPlugin` is unchanged (one-registration constraint); without the seam the guard is not installed, like the read gate and the redaction.
- The approvals service door's own free-text rule (#11040) is unchanged.
- The branch merged `main` twice in patch round 1 (no rebase), last as `ee558beae2`; `main` commits after that touch no file of this diff and merge cleanly with it.

## Patch round 1

The seat decided both open questions (comment `5933122330`): Q1, a query naming no parent object is admitted for a reader withheld nothing on any object those rows can concern, and refused otherwise; Q2, the two guards' census anchors land here. Commits `e8ca01c861` (pins), `0232077761` (fix), `8907accb83` (census), `d0e1c4d8ba` (pin correction), merges `89fc4580a2` and `ee558beae2`; pushed together after the ablation.

### Q1 — a query naming no parent object

- **Rule.** A query that pins one parent object keeps the round-0 rule. A query that pins none is judged against the **declared set**: every object registered in the engine, read from metadata and never from rows, so the set is the same whatever the query and whatever rows it would match (not the read gate's pre-scan). The pinned query's own per-object question (the redaction's served set asked as the caller, against the security service's read projection asked as the system) is asked of each object in turn; the first object that withholds a field refuses the query, in the same words as before. An engine that cannot list its objects refuses.
- **Why every registered object.** The CRUD mirror is registered on every object but its own exclusion list, and that list has grown over time, so rows about an object it now skips can still be at rest; an approval snapshot can concern any object an approval process names. The set is the writers' reach and a superset of it, which can only refuse more.
- **Which fields count.** Every field: a create or delete snapshot records the whole stored record, and rows written before the mirror began masking credential fields are still at rest. The per-object answer is the serve seam's own; masking is not derived a second time.
- **(D) before (B), measured first** on a stock showcase boot with its seeded admin, before the fix: the engine registers 86 objects (80 inside the CRUD mirror's scope), and the admin is withheld no field on any of the 86. (D) keeps the admin's unpinned search, so (B) was not built. Before the fix, that admin's unpinned ledger search, activity search and approval-snapshot filter each answered 403.
- **Cost**, same boot, after the fix, 20 requests per door after one warm-up: an unpinned query naming a value-bearing column adds 258 security-service calls (3 per registered object) for a reader withheld nothing; a restricted reader stops at the first object that withholds. In process the 258 calls take 4 ms cold and 2 ms warm. End to end per request: unpinned ledger search 75.5 ms, ledger list naming no such column 78.7 ms, pinned ledger filter 64.5 ms, unpinned activity search 107.6 ms, unpinned approval filter 77.5 ms; the admission sits inside request-to-request variation. A pinned query is unchanged (3 calls); a query naming no value-bearing column asks the guard nothing.
